editorial:
Imagine starting a dream internship only to fall head-over-heels for the guy working right next to you. That is exactly what happens to Kotori, a sweet university student who finds a spark with Eba. At first, everything feels like a fairy tale. They bond over their work at the publishing house and their love for music, making you really root for them as a couple. The vibe is soft and romantic, but there is a hidden tension that makes you feel like something is slightly off, even when they are at their happiest.

You will notice that the acting is top-notch, especially how the leads show their emotions without saying much. The movie takes a sharp turn that changes everything you thought you knew about their relationship. While the pace slows down in the middle, the emotional payoff is huge. If you enjoy stories that pull at your heartstrings, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Eba is actually a cold person who manipulated Kotori's feelings for his own gain. He used her to get ahead and move up in his career. In the end, Kotori realizes she was just a tool for his ambition. She has to face the pain of this betrayal and learn to stand on her own. The movie wraps up with her finding the strength to move past the heartbreak and start over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional dramas and stories about first love and betrayal.
